findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_market, list_open_orders, read_closed_pnl · Private data: list_connections, propose_close_all_positions, read_onchain_balances, read_venue_balances, daily_prep, reserve_sweep, read_defi, build_defi_tx · Public sink: propose_trade, propose_trade_ideas, propose_bracket, get_insights · Destructive: propose_predict_market, close_position, set_exits, cancel_order, read_risk_limits, daily_prep, execute_trade, reserve_sweep.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_market, list_open_orders, read_closed_pnl · Private data: list_connections, propose_close_all_positions, read_onchain_balances, read_venue_balances, daily_prep, reserve_sweep, read_defi, build_defi_tx · Public sink: propose_trade, propose_trade_ideas, propose_bracket, get_insights · Destructive: propose_predict_market, close_position, set_exits, cancel_order, read_risk_limits, daily_prep, execute_trade, reserve_sweep

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
